assumptions.broadening: CO2 lines self-broadened (look-up axis of CO2 fraction 0.9 and 1.0); H2O broadened by air (H2O is absent from the dry cases)
assumptions.continua: CO2-CO2 collision-induced absorption (Gruszka & Borysow 1998, Mol. Phys. 93, 1007; Baranov et al. 2004, J. Mol. Spectrosc. 228, 432; Wordsworth et al. 2010). H2O continuum MT_CKD 3.0 (unused: no water)
assumptions.continuum_density: k_cont q1 q2 rho with rho = p / (R_mix T) of the stated mixture; continuum look-up (10 K steps) interpolated linearly in T to the gas table's temperatures. Where the source data stop (CO2-CO2 below 200 K) the file itself holds the edge value
assumptions.far_wings: CO2 sub-Lorentzian line shapes (Perrin & Hartmann 1989, JQSRT 42, 311; Wordsworth et al. 2010, Icarus 210, 992). The truncation distance is not stated in the documentation
assumptions.overlap: as flagged in the spectral file: random overlap (products of k-terms) between a gas and a continuum, exact where either has one term. Not a common-wavenumber-grid premix
assumptions.thermal_source: band Planck fractions are computed by the provider (planck_band_fraction); SOCRATES' own Planck table is not used. Nothing is emitted outside the bands

coverage.documented_ranges: opacity look-up tables 100-400 K; Planck table 1-500 K; long-wave accuracy decreases above about 310 K
coverage.documented_validity: CO2-dominated atmospheres with > 90 % CO2, surface pressures up to 10 bar
